Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 1 Purpose of the policy
1.1. The purpose of the Training & Development policy is to ensure all employees possess relevant skills and competencies to perform their job to the best of their knowledge and requirement. The policy shall provide learning opportunities to all employees to motivate and excel in their jobs.

1.2. The vision of the Managing Director is all employees to be involved in "Building of a performance-based organization".

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 2 Scope of the policy
This policy is applicable to all employees, probationers and trainees working at Corporate, Depot, R&D, Factory and Field Force of the Pulse Group.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 3 Mandatory elements of Training
Purpose of Training and Development function of the organization has 5 key elements to development.

3.1 Attract & Retain talent: Training is an enabler to support employee career aspirations, ensuring retention of employee

3.2 Motivate & Engage: Training builds a foundation to help employees perform to the best of their knowledge.

3.3 Build an Employer Brand: Training provides a sense of purpose, and belongingness to an employee, ensuring long-lasting impression in the eyes of the external world.

3.4 Create a value-based culture: Trainings adopt the vision, strategic objectives, mission and values of the organization and train the employees using them as the guiding principles, in turn building a value-based culture.

3.5 Develop people capabilities: Training opportunities enhance knowledge, skills, capabilities through various workshops ensuring building of the right set of skills and capabilities of the employees.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 4 Training & development policy benefits
4.1. Enhanced understanding of Values, vision and mission

4.2. Focused implementation of Strategic objectives

4.3. Higher productivity

4.4. Improved quality of product

4.5. Lower failures

4.6. Higher customer satisfaction

4.7. Alignment of goals and KRAs

4.8. Culture of recognition and appreciation

4.9. Career growth

4.10. Empowerment and personal growth

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 5 The training cycle
the training cycle systematically cascades business goals, behavioral and technical competencies, to all employees. The training department follows the training cycle to ensure the policy is followed in its true letter and spirit.

5.1 Business Goals & Training Needs - Inputs are received from the vison, mission, values, and strategic objectives of the organization, functional and behavioral competencies, statutory requirements, capability building, and appraisal data.

5.2 Competency Framework - to be added here.

5.3 Training Needs Assessment - training is customized to meet each department and employee's needs. Supervisors share feedback of their team members to ensure customization of training intervention. Data is also collected from the Appraisal forms. Training calendar is developed based on the skill gap analysis and as per number of man days finalized. External programs can be added based on level of employee.

5.4 Instructional objective - is about designing program objectives, and delivering results. Training programs are designed based on different learning styles. The 70- 20-10 learning methodology is one such learning style, ensures employees are equally accountable for their own learning.

5.5 Design and Development - using various methodologies to attract, engage and train employees.

a) Class room

b) Online programs

c) Web based simulations

d) Action learning projects

e) Mobile nuggets

f) Seminars

g) Higher education

h) Job rotation

i) Distance learning

j) Deputation for a certain project

k) Self-reading

5.6 Delivery - selection of service providers internally or externally is decided based on the area of expertise and effectiveness. Training program topic, details about duration and objectives are informed well in advance. A pre-assessment and post- assessment is designed and administrated. On the day of the program an ice- breaker is conducted to relax the participants and get them to focus on the program.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 5 The training cycle
During the program it is the trainer's responsibility to keep the employees / participants engaged. Trainer to use Adult Learning Principles to translate knowledge to participants.

5.7 Evaluation - all training programs are evaluated to measure improved performance and trainer's effectiveness. A feedback evaluation form is circulated at the end of the program.

5.7.1. Pre-assessment form

5.7.2. Post-assessment form

5.7.3. Feedback form - to assess relevance of training, trainer's effectiveness, and apt duration of the program. Suggestions are also taken. Feedback of the program is analyzed and shared with the line manager.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 5 The training cycle
Table:
| 70 percent on the job learning | 20 percent learning happens through self-awareness | 10 percent learning through various methodologies like class room |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Using various opportunities in designing, improving on the job and being mentored by Seniors to learn. | Using opportunities to contribute, interact, read, introspect, gain insights, and knowledge to enhance capabilities. | Educational and knowledge or skill- based training happens in Class room, e- learning, mobile learning and through other platforms. |

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 5 The training cycle
Figure: Training cycle (closed loop). Business Goals -> Competency Framework -> Skill gap analysis - Needs Assessment - Training Calendar -> Instructional Objective -> Design and Development -> Delivery -> Evaluate Effectiveness -> back to Business Goals.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 6 Objective of Training & Development
6.1 All employees to be trained on

6.1.1. Safety programs

6.1.2. Technical or functional capabilities

6.1.3. Behavioral competencies

6.1.4. Vision, mission, values and strategic objectives

6.2 All newly hired employees will undergo of company induction.

6.3 All employees will be provided with technical training to be equipped to better perform in their existing and new job roles.

6.4 All employees will receive opportunities to upgrade and update skills as required by the business.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 6 Objective of Training & Development > 6.5 All training activities will target
Topic: 6.5.1 Job performance
6.5.2. Increase in revenue / profitability

6.5.3. Measures to manage costs

6.5.4. Innovation and design

6.5.5. Increase Sales

6.5.6. Higher productivity and efficiencies

6.5.7. Customer delight

6.6 All trainings will be measured and evaluated for relevance and effectiveness of the program delivered.

6.7 Proper utilization of infrastructure and facilities will be ensured.

6.8 Training department will be provided with adequate budget and resources to carry forward the yearly plan.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 7 Roles and responsibilities
7.1 Training department is a centralized function and will service the entire organization.

7.2 Training & Development head of the department (at any post the organization chooses) will report into the Chief Human Resources Officer

7.3. Role of CHRO

7.3.1. Provide advice, assistance and support to the Training & development HOD to conduct trainings for all employees.

7.3.2. Approve training needs assessment and training calendar

7.3.3. Provide budget sanctions

7.3.4. Any other expertise required to conduct technical and functional programs

7.3.5. Give necessary feedback if required

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 7 Roles and responsibilities
Figure: Training function reporting structure. CEO -> Chief Human Resources Officer -> Learning & Development Manager -> Unit 1 Assistant Manager and Unit 2 Assistant Manager.

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 7 Roles and responsibilities > 7.4 Role of Training HOD
Topic: 7.4.1 ensure proper assessment,
coordination, administration and measurement of trainings organized in the organization.

7.4.2. Will report to CHRO

7.4.2. Will maintain all documentation as required, confidentiality of the said records, keep them up-to-date, and ready for audit as required.

7.4.3. Training HOD will manage and coordinate:

7.4.3.1. Training needs identification

7.4.3.2. Training gaps

7.4.3.3. Training calendar

7.4.3.4. List of training programs

7.4.3.5. Availability of trainers as per expertise (Internal and External)

7.4.3.6. KPIs for each training program to measure success of training

7.4.3.7. Maintain and document attendance of each participant attendee.

7.4.3.8. Get feedback filled, collate feedback of each program

7.4.3.9. Measurement of success

7.4.3.10. Budget provision, monitoring, controlling and submitting consolidated statements on a monthly basis.

metadata.breadcrumb: 7 Roles and responsibilities > 7.4 Role of Training HOD

Policy: Pulse Training Policy (Version V.02, effective 2025-01-01)
Policy ID: pulse_training_dev_policy
Section: 7 Roles and responsibilities > 7.5 Role of Training Manager
7.5.1. Obtain data from various sources to develop Training needs assessment (TNI) for conducting various programs on;

7.5.1.1. Safety

7.5.1.2. Technical

7.5.1.3. Behavioral

7.5.2. TNI to capture all employee's data and their trainings they have to attend in a year.

7.5.3. Use TNI to build the Training Calendar

7.5.4. Build a budget based on the number of trainings to be organized

7.5.5. Get a sign off on the budget

7.5.6. Implement the training calendar by organizing internal or external trainers, evaluate and assign trainings as planned

7.5.7. Receive nominations from managers

7.5.8. Ensure attendance, by promoting training benefits to all managers / employees

7.5.9. Organize various modes of delivery like classroom, e-learning, CBT, as per budget available

7.5.10. Finalize content with trainers. Design programs using adult learning principles ensuring relevance to employees

7.5.11. Document attendance of each training, file all documentation for future use

7.5.12. Keep budget under control

7.5.13. Keep manager informed about all progress

metadata.breadcrumb: 7 Roles and responsibilities > 7.5 Role of Training Manager
